summary: Crystalline lens behind the iris; thickens and steepens with age. Cataract findings live in its capsule, cortex and nucleus.

refractive_index.note: Equivalent index; the real lens has a gradient index.

surface_reflectance.note: Normal-incidence Fresnel reflectance of the front and back lens surfaces (Purkinje III and IV), about 3.4e-4. Vitreous index taken equal to aqueous.

diffuse_scatter_gain.note: Room light the lens's scatter returns through the pupil in the external view, so a cataract colours the pupil there. Render-calibrated, not clinically validated.

provenance.source: Atchison & Smith (2000), ch. 2; Dubbelman & van der Heijde, Vision Res 41:1867 (2001) for age changes
